name: sacred-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Sacred, a tool to configure, organize, log and reproduce computational
experiments: experiments and ingredients, configuration scopes, dictionaries, files and named
configurations, captured functions and their special arguments, the command-line interface and its
commands and flags, randomness control, run observers, collected run information, metrics and settings.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the sacred/ package (every Python module under sacred/), together with the documentation pages README.rst, docs/quickstart.rst, docs/experiment.rst, docs/configuration.rst, docs/command_line.rst, docs/ingredients.rst, docs/observers.rst, docs/collected_information.rst, docs/randomness.rst, docs/logging.rst, docs/settings.rst, docs/optional.rst and docs/internals.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with numpy, pandas, PyYAML, Mako, SQLAlchemy, TinyDB, h
